summary: The canonical rule lives in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 (resolveHideBranding: an organization's hideBranding overrides the entity's) with entity-aware wrappers at :85-110/:116-153/:158-164/:169-181. The booking page obeys it — apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299-300, apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199-200, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36-37, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61,103, apps/web/lib/org/[orgSlug]/instant-meeting/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:85-86 and apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-253 all call shouldHideBrandingFor*Event, and the flag gates the logo at apps/web/modules/bookings/components/Booker.tsx:610 rendering apps/web/modules/ee/common/components/PoweredBy.tsx. The automation path reads it from somewhere else. (1) packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 calls getHideBranding({userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId}) — the WORKFLOW's owner, not the booked event type, so a personal workflow firing on a team/org event resolves against the wrong entity. (2) packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, 274-276, 433-435 computes brandingDisabled as `reminder.booking.eventType?.team ? !!team.hideBranding : !!booking.user?.hideBranding`, bypassing resolveHideBranding entirely so the parent-organization override never applies; it cannot apply it because the select at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:162-172,198-203 fetches user.hideBranding and team.{parentId,hideBranding} but never team.parent.hideBranding or the user's org profile. (3) The booking pipeline forwards `!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding` into reminder scheduling — packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618,2793,2808, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459,472, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671, packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230 — which is null for every team event, and the select that feeds it (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:109-113) exposes only owner.hideBranding. That value rides through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56,97,161,213,248,280 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,115,147,182,204 to the renderers that actually append the vendor name: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/customTemplate.ts:216, .../emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-83 and .../emailRatingTemplate.ts:79-80 (`Scheduling by ${APP_NAME}`). apps/api/v2/src/modules/atoms/services/event-types-atom.service.ts:423 repeats the same org-blind `team?.hideBranding || user?.hideBranding` fork.
